subject: Redwood POC - Next Steps and Readout Scheduling
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood POC - Next Steps

Emma — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed POC plan so we’re aligned before kickoff. Please flag anything I missed or want to adjust.

Summary of discovery (high level)
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization + reranking for support knowledge base
- Expected traffic for trial: ~20–60 concurrent requests, peak ~100/minute
- Data sensitivity: customer content (PII redaction required), logs must be restricted and retained for 90 days

Proposed POC objectives / success criteria
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for our canonical prompt (50-token output)
2) Cost: target effective cost < $0.80 per 1k output tokens (measured across trial)
3) Throughput: sustain 50 rps with <10% tail latency growth under load test
4) Quality: >= 85% accept rate on internal eval set (you and product team to validate)
5) Compliance: logs/audit accessible to Acme AI SRE and restricted to named reviewer set

POC plan (timeline & ownership)
- Week 0 (Feb 8–11): Kickoff + environment access, test dataset handoff (Owner: Emma)
- Week 1 (Feb 12–18): Integration + smoke tests (Owner: Laura - SE)
- Week 2 (Feb 19–25): Load testing, quality evals, cost tuning (Owners: Aditya + Laura)
- Final readout: week of Feb 22 — propose Tue, Feb 22, 10:00 AM PT (exec readout + decision)

Deliverables
- POC plan (attached): POC-plan-Redwood-AcmeAI.pdf
- Test harness + sample prompts (we’ll share a link during kickoff)
- Readout deck and metrics + recommendation (we’ll present on final day)

Next steps / asks
- Can you confirm ownership for the eval sign-off (who will be final approver)?
- Confirm that Feb 22, 10:00 AM PT works for the readout (or send alternative windows)
- Please share the initial test corpus by EOD Feb 9 so Laura can start integration

Thanks — I’ll put a calendar hold for Feb 22 tentatively and share the invite after confirmation.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@acmeai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC - Next Steps

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. A few quick notes from our side after speaking with product & ops: 
- Quality: we’ll use a 250-item sample from our support KB + 50 synthetic edge cases; final approver for quality sign-off will be Tom Ellis (CTO) and myself (Emma).
- Latency: we want the 95th < 350ms as a hard requirement (we can revisit if results look good but prefer conservative target).
- Compliance: Can you confirm that logs will be viewable via a read-only link for our auditors and that data retention can be set to 90 days?

Timing: Feb 22 works for an initial readout window; Tom is likely available in the morning (10:00 AM PT is ideal). If we pass, procurement will begin contract discussions the week after and we’ll aim for signature by ~Mar 5.

One ask: please include a short SOW/estimate and any SLA notes ahead of the readout so our procurement team can preview.

Emma
Emma Johnson
Head of AI Products | Acme AI
emma.johnson@acmeai.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC - Next Steps

Appreciate the clarifications, Emma. Quick notes and confirmations: 
- We can set the read-only auditor access and 90-day retention for logs — Laura will confirm the exact audit link format.
- Updated success criteria: we’ll use 95th < 350ms per your ask.
- SOW / estimate & SLA summary: attached SLA-summary.xlsx. I’ll also circulate a one-page SOW and cost estimate by EOD Feb 17 so procurement has something to review before the readout.

Proposed calendar: I’ve tentatively held Tue, Feb 22, 10:00–10:45 AM PT for the final readout (invite will follow). Please reply with the attendee list for the exec readout so I can ensure the deck addresses the right stakeholders.

On procurement timeline: if Acme aims to sign by Mar 5, we should be prepared to answer a few standard items at the readout (SLA, data handling, support escalation). If you want, I can loop legal/procurement from our side to the readout as well.

Thanks — will follow up with the SOW and test-run checklist.

—
Marcus
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC - Next Steps (internal)

Laura / Aditya — heads up on next steps before the readout. Internal action items: 
- Laura: please prepare the integration checklist and test harness (include instructions for the 250-item KB + 50 edge cases). Need a demo script and preliminary run results by EOD Feb 20. Confirm the read-only audit link format so Emma can share with auditors.
- Aditya: please prepare the dedicated capacity estimate and rough cost model for the POC (include projected cost per 1k tokens and best-case tuning suggestions). Draft a one-page SOW for procurement by Feb 20.
- Deck: I’ll draft the readout slide deck — include an appendix with raw metrics and our recommendation (go/no-go).

Attachments: SLA-summary.xlsx (for procurement preview) — see attached.

If we can get the sample run results and SOW by 2/20 we’ll be in good shape for the 2/22 readout.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@acmeai.com>

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmeai.com>, Sara Mills <s.mills@acmeai.com>

Marcus / team — confirming a few items before kickoff: 
- Exec readout attendees: Emma Johnson (Head of AI Products), Tom Ellis (CTO), Sara Mills (VP Product). Other biz stakeholders may join but these three will be decision-makers.
- Decision process: go/no-go will be documented in the readout deck; final approval requires both product (Sara/Emma) and tech (Tom) sign-off. If POC passes the stated criteria we’ll issue a term sheet to proceed; procurement expects to complete signature by ~Mar 5.
- DocuSign: please send the preliminary SOW/term sheet via DocuSign ahead of the readout if possible so procurement can review.

We’ll hand off the sample test set to Laura today (you should see the shared Drive link). 10:00 AM PT on Feb 22 works for the readout. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Emma
